pets.com.summary: Pets.com was a dot-com era online pet-supply retailer that launched in 1998, went public in February 2000, and liquidated just nine months later in November 2000 after failing to reach profitability.

citations.title: Pets.com — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Pets.com ceased operations in November 2000.

citations.title: Pets.com to shut down operations
citations.snippet: Pets.com said Tuesday it will shut down, becoming one of the most spectacular dot-com flops.

blockbuster.summary: Blockbuster, the video-rental chain, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2010; the corporate chain was wound down and only a single independently operated franchise store (in Bend, Oregon) remains.

citations.title: Blockbuster — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Blockbuster LLC filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in September 2010.

citations.title: Blockbuster files for bankruptcy
citations.snippet: Movie-rental company Blockbuster Inc filed for bankruptcy protection.

instagram.summary: Instagram is a photo and video sharing service that was acquired by Facebook (now Meta Platforms) in 2012 for approximately US$1 billion. It continues to operate as a Meta product.

citations.title: Instagram — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Facebook acquired Instagram in April 2012 for about US$1 billion.

citations.title: Facebook to acquire Instagram
citations.snippet: Facebook said it would acquire the photo-sharing service Instagram.

sun microsystems.summary: Sun Microsystems, the maker of Java, Solaris, and SPARC hardware, was acquired by Oracle Corporation in 2010. The Sun brand was retired and its products were folded into Oracle.

citations.title: Sun Microsystems — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Oracle Corporation acquired Sun Microsystems in January 2010.

citations.title: Oracle completes acquisition of Sun
citations.snippet: Oracle Corp completed its acquisition of Sun Microsystems.

lehman brothers.summary: Lehman Brothers, the global investment bank, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2008 — the largest bankruptcy filing in U.S. history — a defining event of the 2008 financial crisis.

citations.title: Lehman Brothers — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Lehman Brothers filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on September 15, 2008.

citations.title: Lehman files for bankruptcy
citations.snippet: Lehman Brothers Holdings filed for bankruptcy protection.

whatsapp.summary: WhatsApp is a messaging application that was acquired by Facebook (now Meta Platforms) in 2014 for roughly US$19 billion. It remains an active Meta product.

citations.title: WhatsApp — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Facebook acquired WhatsApp in February 2014 for approximately US$19 billion.

citations.title: Facebook to buy WhatsApp for $19 billion
citations.snippet: Facebook agreed to buy WhatsApp for $19 billion.

theranos.summary: Theranos was a blood-testing startup whose technology claims were exposed as fraudulent; it ceased operations and was dissolved in 2018, and founder Elizabeth Holmes was later convicted of fraud.

citations.title: Theranos — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Theranos ceased operations and was dissolved in 2018.

citations.title: Theranos to dissolve
citations.snippet: Theranos told investors it would dissolve.

facebook.summary: The company formerly known as Facebook, Inc. renamed its parent corporation to Meta Platforms, Inc. in October 2021. The Facebook social network itself continues to operate as a Meta product.

citations.title: Meta Platforms — Wikipedia
citations.snippet: Facebook, Inc. changed its name to Meta Platforms, Inc. in October 2021.

citations.title: Facebook changes company name to Meta
citations.snippet: Facebook said it had changed its company name to Meta.

ftx.summary: FTX Trading Ltd. and roughly 101 affiliated companies filed voluntary petitions for Chapter 11 reorganization in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware in November 2022. The original FTX exchange no longer operates as the business it was, while the bankruptcy estate continues its court-supervised recovery and distributions.

citations.title: FTX Group Notice Regarding Federal Court Filings and Communications
citations.snippet: FTX Trading Ltd. and approximately 101 additional affiliated companies filed voluntary petitions for reorganization under Chapter 11.

citations.title: FTX bankruptcy case information
citations.snippet: Kroll maintains the official case website for the FTX Chapter 11 proceedings and court filings.

quibi.summary: Quibi was a mobile short-form video service launched in April 2020. In October 2020, after less than seven months, Quibi announced that it would close the business and sell its assets.

citations.title: Quibi is shutting down after subscriber struggles
citations.snippet: Quibi said it will close down the business and begin the process of selling off assets.

citations.title: Quibi says it's shutting down
citations.snippet: Quibi announced that it intended to wind down its business operations and sell its assets.

silicon valley bank.summary: Silicon Valley Bank was closed by California regulators and the FDIC on March 10, 2023. The FDIC transferred deposits and assets to a bridge bank, and First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company assumed the bridge bank's deposits and loans on March 26, 2023; Silicon Valley Bank no longer operates as a standalone bank.

citations.title: Failed Bank Information for Silicon Valley Bank
citations.snippet: Silicon Valley Bank was closed on March 10, 2023; the FDIC transferred deposits and substantially all assets to Silicon Valley Bridge Bank.

citations.title: First-Citizens to Assume All Deposits and Loans of Silicon Valley Bridge Bank
citations.snippet: The FDIC entered into a purchase and assumption agreement for all deposits and loans of Silicon Valley Bridge Bank by First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company.

compaq.summary: Compaq Computer Corporation was merged into Hewlett-Packard in a transaction completed on May 3, 2002. Compaq therefore no longer exists as a standalone company, although its products and operations became part of HP.

citations.title: HP reports fourth-quarter 2002 results
citations.snippet: HP completed its merger transaction involving Compaq Computer Corp. on May 3, 2002.

citations.title: HP history: 2000s
citations.snippet: On May 3, 2002, HP completed its merger transaction with Compaq Computer Corp.

wework.summary: WeWork filed for Chapter 11 in 2023 but announced on June 11, 2024 that it had emerged from Chapter 11 and completed its restructuring. It remains an operating flexible-space provider, though as a restructured private company rather than the pre-bankruptcy public company.

citations.title: WeWork announces emergence from Chapter 11 and new leadership appointments
citations.snippet: WeWork announced that it had successfully emerged from Chapter 11 and completed its global operational and financial restructuring.

citations.title: WeWork
citations.snippet: WeWork's current site continues to offer flexible workspace and office services.
